subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Team Building Retreat
body: Dear Team Members, We are excited to announce our upcoming Annual Team Building Retreat scheduled for next month. This year's event will feature team-building activities, workshops, and a fun networking session. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for more details in the coming weeks. We look forward to strengthening our bond and enhancing teamwork during this retreat. Save the date! Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
